subject: Price housekeeping: DealDesk items affecting Q4 committed forecast
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@palogrid.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Chen <alexc@palogrid.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pricing alignment for PaloGrid renewal

Vanessa / Karthik —

Thanks again for the call this morning. We're roughly aligned on scope for the renewal but need a formal discount approval to move forward. Our procurement team is asking for the final net price and any one-time credits by EOD Wednesday so we can complete the PO for Q4 close.

Quick summary of asks from our side:
- Final net price with seat-band and usage tiers (PDF quote preferred)
- Confirmation of any transactional credits (if applicable) and their expiration
- Short note on data residency and audit logs for compliance

 I've attached the draft renewal terms for reference (PaloGrid_Renewal_Terms_v1.pdf). Can you advise next steps and an ETA for approval?

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement | PaloGrid

Date: 2026-12-06T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Pricing alignment for PaloGrid renewal

Looping in Deal Desk and Finance — PaloGrid is asking for a formal net price and confirmation of a small one-time credit. This looks like a standard renewal but will flow into our Q4 committed pipeline if we sign this week.

Immediate asks for the group:
1) Karthik — can you validate whether the requested credit is within our standard concession bands or requires formal Deal Desk approval?
2) Lauren — if we sign by EOD Wednesday, can Finance accept the PO and reflect the expected commit for Q4 revenue?
3) Markus — any compliance/controls notes we need to include in the quote PDF?

Samantha — thanks for sending the terms. We'll get back with an updated quote and timeline by tomorrow afternoon. If anyone needs to pull in Legal I can do that but would prefer to keep it moving through Deal Desk for speed.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Director | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@palogrid.com>, Alex Chen <alexc@palogrid.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing alignment for PaloGrid renewal — internal price checklist

Thanks Vanessa — quick internal note and proposed steps. I'm tagging this as a potential price exception but below is the checklist I need completed to move to approval: 

DealDesk checklist for RDW-2345:
- Confirm requested credit amount and rationale (Vanessa) — pending
- Confirm committed ARR if signed this quarter (Vanessa/Finance) — pending
- Attach customer PO terms and expected signature date (Samantha has sent draft)
- Validate margin impact and concessions cap (Finance / Lauren) — action item for Lauren
- Approve or escalate to Pricing Committee if > concession cap (currently 10%) — I will review once numbers are in

I've attached the current exceptions log for reference — pricing-exceptions-log.csv. Please update the file with the proposed credit amount and ETA; I will run the margin calc and give a decision within 4 business hours of receipt. If the credit pushes net below our concession threshold we'll need a short approval note for the Committee.

Operational note for forecasting: if we approve this and PaloGrid signs this week, mark RDW-2345 as a Q4 commit in CRM with the signed date and final net ARR. If approval is delayed beyond next Tuesday we need to move the deal to best-case (no commit) to keep the forecast conservative.

Karthik
Head, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

Quick update: Finance can accept the PO and reflect the commit for Q4 provided we receive the signed PO by 2026-12-09 17:00 PT and the credit does not exceed the 10% concession cap. I've updated CRM (Deal RDW-2345) to stage: Closed - Commit (pending signature) with expected close date 2026-12-09.

Vanessa — please confirm the final credit amount in the exceptions log and I'll finalize the margin entry. If the credit exceeds cap, please flag and I'll pause the commit until Deal Desk confirms committee approval.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
